title: your phone eats the first hour of your day
format: Empathy → "so I made X for people like me" → product screenshot with a white-box CTA
why: Second take on charlotte's 2.0M-like disguised promo, morning angle: a dim film-still of a dawn bedroom with a phone lit on the pillow carries the feeling, a film-still of two people walking away down a cobbled street at sunrise carries the confession (walking = the 200 steps), then a full-bleed screenshot of the real step-count Home with one white box mid-screen. Sentence case, TikTok Classic white, centred.
caption: for everyone whose phone gets the first hour #screentime #morningroutine #doomscrolling
sound: soft ambient / sleepy lo-fi (the ref uses its own playlist audio)
check: slide 2: "it helped" must be true for you
slide 2: the walk wake-up is set to 200 steps on your phone (it is the default)
AI-made photos (slides 1 and 2, slide 2 shows two people from behind): turn on TikTok's AI-generated label
promo: turn on TikTok's "Your brand" disclosure
slide 3 is a crop of the real Home render (02-steps-clean); fine as is

caps.text: I know that feeling when your phone eats the first hour of your day

So I made an app for people like me that locks my apps till I walk 200 steps and it helped
